description: Dear Friends and Neighbors,My End-of-Session Legislative Update went out in the mail last week to households across House District 78, and I wanted to make sure it reached your inbox, too. Every session, I come back to one question: Will this make life better for the families in our community? This year, that meant protecting our children as they grow up online, helping renters and homeowners hold onto a stable place to live, standing up for public safety, and working to deliver real tax relief
